source: 用户已确认的盘序 v0.2 交互原型

formControls.focusBoundary: single 2px accent outline, inset 1px; compound inputs own only the outer boundary

dataFeedback.firstRead: region placeholder, never a false zero count
dataFeedback.refresh: retain content; show progress in existing control or heading
dataFeedback.empty: shared title, description and action; fill bounded list region
dataFeedback.failure: one persistent recovery region with retry
dataFeedback.motion: static skeletons; only the progress icon rotates, disabled with reduced motion

toastFeedback.contract: src/lib/feedback.ts; notify(text, tone) requires an explicit tone
toastFeedback.dismissal: success/info: 6500ms, paused while hovered or focused; error/warning: manual close

accountManagement.layout: responsive account rows with identity / capacity / contextual actions; actions flow below on narrower workspaces
accountManagement.icons: src/resources/ProviderIcon.tsx with local assets in src/assets/providers
accountManagement.creation: header action reveals an inline form; empty workspace reveals it initially; saved account receives login focus
accountManagement.selection: current account is local to the workspace and independent of the per-provider default
accountManagement.capacity: src/accounts/Capacity.tsx; retained previous values and explicit refresh; unknown never becomes zero
accountManagement.security: credential removal confirms scope and explains account disabling; enabled and default operations retain backend rules
